summary: Mineral County, MT, Lolo NF: 30-foot platform tower, about 1927, abandoned 1941 per firelookout.com; marked gone. No description of the site today found.

facts.status_note: Abandoned 1941 and marked gone by firelookout.com and the FFLA list; no source describes what remains today

evidence.supports: Lolo National Forest as the agency

evidence.quote: This 30' platform tower, constructed about 1927, was abandoned in 1941.

evidence.supports: end date left open with a question mark
page credits its photo to the Fire Lookout Museum
evidence.quote: Photo courtesy the Fire Lookout Museum

evidence.supports: FFLA lists Flat Ridge, Mineral, as a tower and gone

notes_for_editor: Both sources are firelookout.com and the FFLA list; the FFLA list only repeats 'Tower Gone'. Two web searches found no independent record of a Flat Ridge lookout on the Lolo, so the 1927 and 1941 dates are single-source and the 1927 date is approximate per the source. height_m 9.1 is converted from the page's 30 feet (no cab, so this is tower height). The record's coordinates were not checked against the '2 miles NNE of Superior' description. No access source found, so facts.access is omitted. Record kind 'tower' and status 'gone' agree with the sources; no corrections proposed.
